name: Realm of Forgotten Souls
summary: Realm of Forgotten Souls is a free dark fantasy MMORPG in the spirit of the classic online RPGs. Create your hero and explore a shared world of walled towns, haunted wilds and buried crypts alongside players from everywhere. Choose between four paths, Fighter, Ranger, Mage and Healer, each growing by how you play. Found a clan, forge alliances and go to war with rival clans, hunt monsters for gold and gear, take on quests, trade, team up in parties and climb the leaderboards.
